procedures.title: Service Test 40: Compressor & sealed system
procedures.purpose: Compressor and Compartment Freezing Cooling Test

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: Continue in Bella Diagnostics
steps.body: Diagnostics active. Use Up/Down to navigate; Icemaker2 to select test.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Diagnostics active. Use Up/Down to navigate; Icemaker2 to select test.

steps.title: Select Service Test 40
steps.body: In Diagnostics (Recommended+Drawer hold 5 s), use Up/Down to test 40. Press Icemaker2 to select. Fast Cool backs out.

steps.title: Run test 40 steps
steps.body: Steps 01–05: 3-way valve chatter, compressor on, RC/FC fans. Time compressor run.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Steps 01–05: 3-way valve chatter, compressor on, RC/FC fans. Time compressor run.

steps.title: Test 40 results
steps.body: 3-way repositions? Compressor runs sustained? RC/FC fans blow cold air?
steps.sourceExcerpt: 3-way repositions? Compressor runs sustained? RC/FC fans blow cold air?

steps.title: Compressor resistances
steps.body: Power off. Common-sensor 14–19 Ω; line-common 7–13 Ω; line-sensor 21–32 Ω.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off. Common-sensor 14–19 Ω; line-common 7–13 Ω; line-sensor 21–32 Ω.

steps.title: Compressor sensor winding
steps.body: Sensor winding 14–19 Ω.

steps.title: 3-way valve coil
steps.body: 43–49 Ω center to each outer pin.
steps.sourceExcerpt: 43–49 Ω center to each outer pin.
